title: Oh guarda il demonietto!
subtitle: Susanna: recitative from Le nozze di Figaro, Act 2
note: Susanna watches Cherubino run off and hides in the closet herself
about: Score: the recitative “Oh guarda il demonietto!” after No. 14 (vocal score pages 137, 7 bars), from Paul Klengel's piano reduction in the Breitkopf & Härtel vocal score (Edition Breitkopf 1716, about 1900), public domain.
